fresh_process_result: Three separate count1 processes per variant reset detector deduplication. Before publication failed 3/3; teardown failed only 2/3 (fresh-2 passed). Before process outcomes were 1P2F, 2P1F, 1P2F with matching 2,1,2 race reports. After each process passed all three without races. The missed teardown race rejects this common-start fixture as the deterministic gate; the later access-barrier v2 proof is separate.
initial_count3_result: Before 7 pass/2 fail with 2 race reports; after 9 pass/0 fail. Go race detector deduplicates repeated stack sites within one process, so later before passes in that invocation are not repeated absence evidence.
positive_control: A real acquired route snapshot writer reference holds external CloseMultiRouteWriter in retirement. Statistics must complete before that reference is released, proving the sequence publication lock does not span external lifecycle waits.
root_mechanism: A common start barrier publishes initialized fixture state to independent reader/lifecycle workers without ordering their accesses to the handle. Teardown runs actual RouteManager retirement concurrently with DestinationSendStats. Opening runs actual RouteManager publication concurrently with the policy reader. No sleeps or retry/poll loops manufacture overlap.
